line: Vienna's five U-Bahn lines are pulled taut out of their real tracks; on a real Thursday night the last trains run home and every line goes dark by half past one, and twenty-four hours later the trains are still running every 15 minutes.
line_cn: 维也纳地铁的五条线从真实轨道里被拉直成形；真实的周四夜里，末班车一列列开回终点，一点半整张图都暗了；二十四小时后的周五夜里，一点半，列车还在每 15 分钟一班地开。
uses: A metro or tram network's real service, from a published timetable
Two days, two nights or two timetables of one network, compared
One line drawn out of its real track, station by station
